code: set.seed(5) n <- 4 * 24 * 60 wet <- stats::runif(n / 16) < 0.12 rain <- rep(ifelse(wet, stats::rgamma(n / 16, 0.8, scale = 2.5), 0), each = 16) / 4 forcing <- data.frame(rain = rain, pet = 0.01) truth <- pdm_model(area_km2 = 60, fc = 1.1, dt = 0.25,                    surface = FlodeCascadeRouting(k1 = 3, k2 = 5)) model <- pdm_model(area_km2 = 60, fc = 1.0, dt = 0.25,                    surface = FlodeCascadeRouting(k1 = 2, k2 = 4)) observed <- run_pdm(truth, forcing, initial_state_from_flow(truth, 1, 0.7))$output$q_m3s *   exp(stats::rnorm(n, 0, 0.01)) simulated <- run_pdm(model, forcing, initial_state_from_flow(model, 1, 0.7))$output$q_m3s error <- observed - simulated days <- (n - 4 * 24 * 10 + 1):n hours <- (days - days[1]) / 4 par(mfrow = c(2, 1), mar = c(2, 4.2, 0.6, 0.6)) plot(hours, observed[days], pch = 16, cex = 0.2, col = pal[1], xlab = "", ylab = "Flow (m3/s)") lines(hours, simulated[days], col = pal[2], lwd = 1.5) par(mar = c(4, 4.2, 0.6, 0.6)) plot(hours, error[days], type = "l", col = pal[3], lwd = 1.5, xlab = "Hours",      ylab = "Error (m3/s)") abline(h = 0, col = pal[7], lty = 2)

code: project <- function(a, start, steps) {   e <- start   out <- numeric(steps)   for (k in seq_len(steps)) {     out[k] <- sum(a * e)     e <- c(out[k], e[-length(e)])   }   out } steps <- 4 * 48 lead <- seq_len(steps) / 4 par(mar = c(4, 4.2, 0.6, 0.6)) plot(range(lead), c(0, 1), type = "n", xlab = "Lead time (h)", ylab = "Predicted error (m3/s)") for (i in 1:3) {   a <- c(0.9, 0.98, 0.995)[i]   lines(lead, project(a, 1, steps), col = pal[i + 1], lwd = 2) } legend("topright", paste("a =", c(0.9, 0.98, 0.995)), col = pal[2:4], lwd = 2, bty = "n")

The family is built for 15-minute steps and is stable only for a decay of at least 4.88 steps (4.88 h here). Use a finer step, a longer decay, ar_ea_default() or fitted coefficients." half <- n / 2 high <- unname(stats::quantile(observed[seq_len(half)], 0.9)) time_to_peak <- pdm_response_time(model, flow = high)$time_to_peak_h dmca <- response_time_dmca(rain[seq_len(half)], observed[seq_len(half)], dt = 0.25)$response_h c(time_to_peak_h = round(time_to_peak, 2), dmca_h = dmca) #> time_to_peak_h         dmca_h  #>           2.78           2.00 compare <- pdm_hindcast(model, forcing, observed, window = (half + 1):n, every_h = 6,                         horizon_h = 24, response_flow = high,                         ar = list(time_to_peak = ar_from_response_time(time_to_peak, 0.25),                                   dmca = ar_from_response_time(dmca, 0.25))) compare_scores <- hindcast_scores(compare) compare_scores <- compare_scores[compare_scores$lead_h %in% c(1, 3, 6, 12, 24) &                                    compare_scores$method %in% c("time_to_peak", "dmca"), ] skill <- data.table::dcast(data.table::as.data.table(compare_scores), lead_h ~ method,                            value.var = "skill") skill$difference <- skill$dmca - skill$time_to_peak round(skill, 4) #> Key: <lead_h> #>    lead_h   dmca time_to_peak difference #>     <num>  <num>        <num>      <num> #> 1:      1 0.8720       0.8716      4e-04 #> 2:      3 0.9159       0.9151      7e-04 #> 3:      6 0.9393       0.9386      7e-04 #> 4:     12 0.9603       0.9601      2e-04 #> 5:     24 0.9658       0.9657      0e+00 basins <- file.path(tempdir(), "ar-basins") output <- file.path(tempdir(), "ar-projects") unlink(c(basins, output), recursive = TRUE) sample <- synthetic_basins(basins, n = 8, years = 2, dt = 1, seed = 21) old <- options(pdmS7.user = "Ann Custodian", pdmS7.role = "custodian") limited <- identical(toupper(Sys.getenv("_R_CHECK_LIMIT_CORES_")), "TRUE") cores <- if (limited) 2L else min(4L, max(1L, parallel::detectCores() - 1L)) # The made-up basins' rain is biased by a known factor, so the rainfall factor is searched. status <- calibrate_batch(basins, output, starts = 2, control = list(maxit = 30),                           overrides = list(fc = c(0.6, 1.6)), cores = cores) options(old) stable_set <- function(h) tryCatch(ar_from_response_time(h, 1), error = function(e) NULL) per_basin <- lapply(sample$basin, function(id) {   dir <- file.path(basins, id)   f <- as.data.frame(data.table::fread(file.path(dir, "forcing.csv")))   obs <- data.table::fread(file.path(dir, "flow.csv"))$q_m3s   meta <- yaml::read_yaml(file.path(dir, "basin.yml"))   day <- substr(f$time, 1, 10)   cal <- match(meta$calibration[[1]], day):max(which(day == meta$calibration[[2]]))   val <- match(meta$validation[[1]], day):max(which(day == meta$validation[[2]]))   project <- file.path(output, id)   fitted <- pdm_from_config(read_entry(project, read_projects(project)$candidate)$configuration)   q90 <- unname(stats::quantile(obs[cal], 0.9, na.rm = TRUE))   ttp <- suppressWarnings(pdm_response_time(fitted, flow = q90))$time_to_peak_h   dm <- response_time_dmca(f$rain[cal], obs[cal], dt = 1)$response_h   sets <- Filter(Negate(is.null), list(time_to_peak = stable_set(ttp), dmca = stable_set(dm)))   out <- data.frame(basin = id, time_to_peak_h = round(ttp, 1), dmca_h = dm,                     time_to_peak_stable = !is.null(sets$time_to_peak),                     dmca_stable = !is.null(sets$dmca), change_3h = NA, change_12h = NA,                     change_24h = NA)   if (length(sets) == 2) {     hc <- suppressWarnings(pdm_hindcast(fitted, f, obs, window = val, every_h = 6,                                         horizon_h = 24, ar = sets, response_flow = q90))     sc <- hindcast_scores(hc)     at <- function(m, h) sc$skill[sc$method == m & sc$lead_h == h]     out[c("change_3h", "change_12h", "change_24h")] <- vapply(c(3, 12, 24), function(h) {       at("dmca", h) - at("time_to_peak", h)     }, numeric(1))   }   out }) by_basin <- do.call(rbind, per_basin) by_basin[c("change_3h", "change_12h", "change_24h")] <-   round(by_basin[c("change_3h", "change_12h", "change_24h")], 4) by_basin #>   basin time_to_peak_h dmca_h time_to_peak_stable dmca_stable change_3h #> 1  S001           19.5     11                TRUE        TRUE    0.0001 #> 2  S002            6.8      4                TRUE       FALSE        NA #> 3  S003            9.0      5                TRUE        TRUE   -0.0004 #> 4  S004            4.3      2               FALSE       FALSE        NA #> 5  S005           16.4      9                TRUE        TRUE   -0.0002 #> 6  S006           33.1     18                TRUE        TRUE   -0.0011 #> 7  S007            3.9      2               FALSE       FALSE        NA #> 8  S008            5.2      3                TRUE       FALSE        NA #>   change_12h change_24h #> 1     0.0008    -0.0017 #> 2         NA         NA #> 3    -0.0035    -0.0046 #> 4         NA         NA #> 5    -0.0012    -0.0085 #> 6     0.0051    -0.0084 #> 7         NA         NA #> 8         NA         NA

code: set.seed(1) n <- 1000 forcing <- data.frame(rain = ifelse(stats::runif(n) < 0.3, stats::rgamma(n, 0.7, scale = 4), 0),                       pet = 0.1) temperature <- 2 + 6 * sin(seq_len(n) / 80) model <- pdm_model(area_km2 = 50) snow <- pack_from_config(pack_presets()) time_per_step <- function(engine, expr) {   old <- options(pdmS7.engine = engine)   on.exit(options(old))   reps <- if (engine == "r") 1 else 50   unname(system.time(for (i in seq_len(reps)) force(expr()))[["elapsed"]]) / reps / n * 1e6 } timings <- rbind(   PDM = c(R = time_per_step("r", function() run_pdm(model, forcing)),           C = time_per_step("auto", function() run_pdm(model, forcing))),   PACK = c(R = time_per_step("r", function() sim_pack(forcing$rain, temperature, snow)),            C = time_per_step("auto", function() sim_pack(forcing$rain, temperature, snow))) ) par(mar = c(4, 5, 1, 1)) barplot(t(timings), beside = TRUE, log = "y", col = pal[c(2, 1)], border = NA,         ylab = "Microseconds per step\n(log scale)", ylim = c(0.2, 5000)) legend("topright", c("R loop", "C core"), fill = pal[c(2, 1)], border = NA, bty = "n",        cex = 0.8) round(timings, 1) #>         R   C #> PDM  1909 2.8 #> PACK  473 1.5

code: gcc -std=c99 -O2 -shared -fPIC src/pdm_core.c -lm -o libpdmcore.so import ctypes  lib = ctypes.CDLL("./libpdmcore.so")  class Route(ctypes.Structure):     _fields_ = [("type", ctypes.c_int32), ("smith", ctypes.c_int32)] + [         (name, ctypes.c_double) for name in "k1 k2 k m rtol atol a gamma".split()]  class Params(ctypes.Structure):     _fields_ = [("distribution", ctypes.c_int32), ("recharge", ctypes.c_int32)] + [         (name, ctypes.c_double)         for name in "cmin cmax b mean meanlog sdlog kg bg st alpha beta qsat".split()] + [         ("surface", Route), ("groundwater", Route)] + [         (name, ctypes.c_double) for name in "be fc td qc area_km2 dt".split()]  assert ctypes.sizeof(Route) == 72 and ctypes.sizeof(Params) == 296  D = ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double) lib.pdm_state_length.restype = ctypes.c_int64 lib.pdm_state_length.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(Params)] lib.pdm_state_from_flow.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(Params), ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double,                                     ctypes.c_double, D, ctypes.c_int64, ctypes.c_char_p,                                     ctypes.c_int64] lib.pdm_run.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(Params), D, D, ctypes.c_int64, D, ctypes.c_int64, D, D,                         D, ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_int64]  # The default model: Pareto soil store, standard recharge, cascade surface, cubic groundwater. p = Params(distribution=0, recharge=0, cmin=0, cmax=140, b=0.4, kg=24, bg=1, st=0,            be=1, fc=1, td=0, qc=0, area_km2=50, dt=1) p.surface = Route(type=0, k1=2, k2=4) p.groundwater = Route(type=1, k=1 / 10000, m=3, rtol=1e-8, atol=1e-10)  n = 48 rain = (ctypes.c_double * n)(*([0.0] * 6 + [4.0] * 6 + [0.0] * 36)) pet = (ctypes.c_double * n)(*([0.1] * n)) length = lib.pdm_state_length(ctypes.byref(p)) state = (ctypes.c_double * length)() q = (ctypes.c_double * n)() q_end = (ctypes.c_double * n)() message = ctypes.create_string_buffer(256)  # Warm start in steady state with 0.8 m3/s, 70 per cent baseflow, then run. assert lib.pdm_state_from_flow(ctypes.byref(p), 0.8, 0.7, 0.5, state, length,                                message, 256) == 0, message.value assert lib.pdm_run(ctypes.byref(p), rain, pet, n, state, length, q, q_end, None,                    message, 256) == 0, message.value print([round(x, 3) for x in q[:12]]) m <- pdm_model(area_km2 = 50) storm <- data.frame(rain = c(rep(0, 6), rep(4, 6), rep(0, 36)), pet = 0.1) round(run_pdm(m, storm, initial_state_from_flow(m, 0.8, 0.7))$output$q_m3s[1:12], 3) #>  [1]  0.796  0.776  0.748  0.718  0.691  0.666  0.955  2.409  4.538  6.846 #> [11]  9.084 11.141

code: basins <- file.path(tempdir(), "basins") set.seed(2024) n <- 24 * 60 time <- seq(as.POSIXct("2023-10-01", tz = "UTC"), by = 3600, length.out = n) truths <- list() for (i in 1:8) {   id <- sprintf("B%02d", i)   folder <- file.path(basins, id)   dir.create(folder, recursive = TRUE)   wet <- stats::runif(1, 0.04, 0.09)   forcing <- data.frame(     time = format(time, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),     rain = ifelse(stats::runif(n) < wet, stats::rgamma(n, 0.7, scale = stats::runif(1, 2, 4)), 0),     pet = round(stats::runif(1, 0.04, 0.09), 3)   )   truth <- pdm_presets("standard")   truth$area_km2 <- round(stats::runif(1, 10, 200))   truth$fc <- stats::runif(1, 0.9, 1.2)   truth$distribution$cmax <- stats::runif(1, 80, 250)   truth$recharge$kg <- exp(stats::runif(1, log(20), log(300)))   k <- sort(stats::runif(2, 1, 12))   truth$surface$k1 <- k[1]   truth$surface$k2 <- k[2]   truths[[id]] <- truth   # The river is already flowing when the record starts: steady state, not empty stores.   model <- pdm_from_config(truth)   flow <- run_pdm(model, forcing[, c("rain", "pet")],                   initial_state_from_flow(model, truth$area_km2 / 50, 0.7))$output$q_m3s *     exp(stats::rnorm(n, 0, 0.04))   if (id == "B06") forcing$pet[100:110] <- -0.05   data.table::fwrite(forcing, file.path(folder, "forcing.csv"))   data.table::fwrite(data.frame(q_m3s = flow), file.path(folder, "flow.csv"))   writeLines(c(     paste("catchment:", paste("Example", id)),     paste("gauge:", id),     paste("area_km2:", truth$area_km2),     "calibration: [2023-10-11, 2023-11-14]",     "validation: [2023-11-15, 2023-11-29]",     "wettest_years: 0"   ), file.path(folder, "basin.yml")) } list.files(basins) #> [1] "B01" "B02" "B03" "B04" "B05" "B06" "B07" "B08" cat(readLines(file.path(basins, "B01", "basin.yml")), sep = "\n") #> catchment: Example B01 #> gauge: B01 #> area_km2: 80 #> calibration: [2023-10-11, 2023-11-14] #> validation: [2023-11-15, 2023-11-29] #> wettest_years: 0

code: set.seed(4) grid <- list(x = seq(500, 29500, by = 1000), y = seq(500, 29500, by = 1000)) nx <- length(grid$x) ny <- length(grid$y) steps <- 600 gx <- matrix(grid$x, nx, ny) gy <- matrix(grid$y, nx, ny, byrow = TRUE) truth <- array(0, c(nx, ny, steps)) for (k in 1:60) {   t0 <- sample.int(steps - 12, 1)   cx <- runif(1, 0, 30000)   cy <- runif(1, 0, 30000)   size <- runif(1, 2000, 6000)   peak <- rexp(1, 1 / 4)   for (s in 0:11) {     truth[, , t0 + s] <- truth[, , t0 + s] +       peak * exp(-((gx - cx - 800 * s)^2 + (gy - cy)^2) / (2 * size^2)) * exp(-s / 4)   } } bias <- 0.6 + 0.6 * gx / 30000 radar <- truth * as.vector(bias) * exp(rnorm(length(truth), 0, 0.25)) gauges <- data.frame(id = LETTERS[1:10], x = runif(10, 2000, 28000), y = runif(10, 2000, 28000)) at <- list(i = vapply(gauges$x, function(v) which.min(abs(grid$x - v)), 1L),            j = vapply(gauges$y, function(v) which.min(abs(grid$y - v)), 1L)) gauge_rain <- t(vapply(seq_len(steps), function(t) truth[cbind(at$i, at$j, t)], numeric(10))) *   exp(rnorm(steps * 10, 0, 0.05)) boundary <- data.frame(x = c(11000, 18000, 19000, 12000), y = c(11000, 10500, 17000, 17500)) mask <- catchment_mask(grid$x, grid$y, boundary) sum(mask) #> [1] 42

code: set.seed(8) n <- 24 * 40 time <- seq(as.POSIXct("2024-01-01", tz = "UTC"), by = 3600, length.out = n) forcing <- data.frame(time = time, pet = 0.04,                       rain = ifelse(stats::runif(n) < 0.08, stats::rgamma(n, 0.7, scale = 4), 0)) truth <- pdm_presets("standard") truth$area_km2 <- 50 truth$recharge$kg <- 300 truth$distribution$cmax <- 120 run <- function(config) {   model <- pdm_from_config(config)   run_pdm(model, forcing, initial_state_from_flow(model, 1, 0.6))$output$q_m3s } observed <- run(truth) * exp(stats::rnorm(n, 0, 0.03)) faulty <- truth faulty$fc <- 0.92 faulty$surface$k1 <- 4 faulty$surface$k2 <- 7 simulated <- run(faulty) par(mar = c(3, 4.2, 0.6, 0.6)) plot(time, observed, pch = 16, cex = 0.3, col = pal[5], xlab = "", ylab = "Flow (m3/s)") lines(time, simulated, col = pal[1], lwd = 1.5)

text: flow-duration curve sorts flows highest lowest, ignoring timing. shows whether model right regime, even timing wrong. Yilmaz et al. (2008) summarise three numbers.
